words.definition:
A shortened form of a word or phrase.
LOL is an abbreviation for “laugh out loud”.

A state of temporary inactivity.
The building of the new playground was held in abeyance until further funding could be secured.

Talent, skill or proficiency in a particular area.
The talent show gave us a chance to see her musical ability.

To solemnly renounce a belief or cause.
Edward VIII decided to abjure the throne in order to marry the woman of his choice.

An act of washing oneself.
He performed his morning ablution before starting his day.

To occur in great quantity.
There is a stream in the woods where fisherman flock because the trout abound there.

To wear off by scraping or rubbing.
The skin on her knee was abraded when she fell on the concrete.

An area damaged by scraping or wearing away.
He got an abrasion on his knee when he fell off the slide.

Sudden and unexpected.
She was confused by her sister’s abrupt departure from the party.

To declare a person free from guilt or wrongdoing.
The lawyer tried to absolve his client of any blame.

Difficult to understand.
The books in the antique bookshop were abstruse.

A deep or seemingly bottomless chasm.
The deep-sea diver loved to go snorkeling in the abyss of the ocean.

Enthusiastic and public praise.
She won acclaim for her commitment to the environment.

The act of getting the position without an election due to being the only candidate.
Three of the positions on the student council were appointed by acclamation.

Recognition.
The team received many accolades after winning the championship.

To make someone aware of or familiar with.
The dog sitter had to acquaint herself with the dog’s habits.

The purchase or addition of something.
The acquisition of math skills helped her win a graduation prize.

A synthetic textile fibre.
Most fibres made of acrylic are non-flammable.

The ability to make good judgements.
The store owner’s business acumen helped make him successful.

Lying near or close by; adjoining.
His best friend lived in the house adjacent to his.

To make a formal judgement in a competition.
She was asked to help adjudicate the speech arts competition.

A natural attraction to a person or liking for a thing.
He was fun to watch in the rodeo because of his strong affinity with horses.

A desert plant.
The agave has narrow spiny leaves and tall flower spikes.

With hands on hips and elbows turned outwards.
When the children came home late they found their mother standing with her arms akimbo.

A plant widely cultivated as a forage crop.
Many farmers grow alfalfa for animal feed.

To reduce or relieve a problem.
Yoga helps to alleviate stress.

A union formed by agreement; a joining of interests.
The European Union is a trade alliance.

In reference to biology, occurring in non-overlapping geographical areas.
Even though the plant species was the same, they had allopatric distribution.

An annual calendar containing important dates and statistical information.
The fisherman might consult the almanac for tide tables.

Available as another possibility or choice.
Épelle-Moi is a French alternative to the English spelling bee.

A mixture or blend.
The wedding was an amalgam of traditional and modern traditions.

To change the form of something, such as a law, by addition or deletion.
The committee will amend the proposal before we vote on it.

A cold-blooded vertebrate adapted to life in the water or on land.
The bull frog is my favourite amphibian.

A disorder characterized by a deficiency of red blood cells.
Pallor and weariness are symptoms of anemia.

An X-ray picture of blood vessels, used to show any abnormality in the flow of blood.
An angiogram is usually performed in a hospital.

Very great pain or grief.
The girl felt great anguish over losing her dog.

A response to a question.
He was asked to put his answer in writing.

A product that destroys or weakens harmful micro-organisms.
Penicillin is an antibiotic commonly used to fight infections.

Having the effect of inhibiting clotting of the blood.
After developing several blood clots he had to take an anticoagulant medication.

Too old for work, service, or use.
Their old computer was antiquated and no longer ran programmes well.

Poise or self-confidence.
She demonstrated aplomb in the spelling bee final.

A punctuation mark used to show the omission of letters or to indicate possession.
In writing, we use an apostrophe “s” to show possession.

A tube-shaped sac attached to the large intestine.
In humans, the appendix has no known function.

Hooked or curved.
They could tell it was an eagle by the aquiline beak.

Referring to land suitable for growing crops.
He had 90 acres of arable land and 10 acres of woodlot.

Erratic or unpredictable.
A good leader is never arbitrary.

A person who studies history by examining objects dug up from the ground.
It is amazing to see the painstaking techniques used by the archeologist at the dig.

An array of resources.
We have an arsenal of computers at our disposal.

Large calibre guns.
During the war games, the military used heavy artillery.

Relating to or deriving from Asia.
There are differences between African and Asiatic lions.

To make a physical attack on someone or something.
The policeman suffered an assault when trying to make an arrest.

An appointment or rendezvous.
The children thought it would be fun to have a secret club and meet potential members at an assignation.

A chronic breathing disorder.
A person with asthma has trouble breathing, especially on humid days.

Shelter or protection from danger.
Some churches provide asylum for the homeless.

Gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
Part of the sun’s energy is absorbed by Earth’s atmosphere.

To gradually decline in ability due to underuse or neglect.
The imagination can atrophy from lack of use.

An accomplishment; something that is achieved.
Everyone commended him for his impressive attainment in winning the spelling bee.

Hair that is reddish brown or golden-brown in colour.
She donated her long auburn hair for a wig for cancer patients.

A distinctive atmosphere or pervasive quality that seems to come from a person.
The person who got the job exuded an aura of confidence throughout the interview.

Usual or ordinary.
She was described as being of average height

Filled with wonder and admiration.
I was awestruck by the beauty and grandeur of the Grand Canyon.

A pointed tool used for making small holes in leather or wood.
Use an awl to make another hole in your belt.

Rawhide thongs or lacings.
Canadians often use babiche in making snowshoes.

Luggage or suitcases.
He did not want to check his baggage so he used only a carry-on bag.

A large African xylophone.
One of the members of the band played a balafon.

An even distribution of weight enabling someone to remain upright and steady.
The tight-rope walker had perfect balance on the wire.

An ancient catapult used for throwing large stones.
We saw a ballista at the war museum.

A bench that has an upholstered seat and is placed along a wall.
At the restaurant they chose a corner table with a banquette.

A marine crustacean that spends its entire adult life attached to some underwater object.
We saw a huge barnacle stuck to the rock during low tide.

A clay-like mineral or rock.
The chief use of bauxite is in the manufacture of aluminum.

To dress up or decorate gaudily.
She really wanted to bedizen her Hallowe’en costume.

To resent or be dissatisfied with; to envy someone’s possessions.
I couldn’t begrudge her the new cell phone as she worked so hard for it.

A structure designed to be opened on several sides to afford a wide view.
We overlooked the city from a belvedere.

A person who gives money to help a person or cause.
The hospital was grateful for the donation from the benefactor to build the new fracture clinic.

Deprived or lacking something.
Because the room was bereft of colour it appeared cold and sterile.

Cruel or savage; of or like a beast.
The bestial zodiac signs include the bull and the ram.

A group of birds or animals.
We saw a bevy of quail on our walk.

Occurring twice a year.
The family liked to take a biannual vacation.

Having two axes.
A biaxial graph has both a vertical and horizontal axis.

Having to do with two languages; able to speak two languages fluently.
Canada is a bilingual country.

Nauseated or sickly.
A child with bilious vomiting might need to be seen by a doctor.

Relating to living organisms.
Ultraviolet radiation from the sun is harmful to biological organisms.

An area or region that constitutes a natural ecological community.
Each bioregion has a distinct flora, fauna and ecosystem from those of other areas.

An unusual mark on a body that is there from birth.
He was identified by his unusual birthmark.

A small, soft round cake like a scone.
For breakfast I like sausage and egg on a biscuit.

Brazenly obvious; forcing one’s attention.
His loud behaviour was a blatant attempt to disturb us.

A thick stick used as a weapon.
The story set in medieval times held him spellbound reading about the guard standing ready with his bludgeon.

Carried or transported.
In pollination, some seeds are borne by the wind.

Abundant or plentiful.
People worry that Canada’s bountiful supply of water could be in danger.

One who is boastful or conceited.
The hockey star was a braggart about her skills.

A type of German pork sausage.
They liked to eat bratwurst in a bun.

A short, stiff hair especially on an animal’s back, often used for making brushes.
A bristle came out of the paint brush and stuck to the wall.

A vegetable that resembles a tree in shape; a variety of cabbage.
It is probably safe to say that broccoli is not the favourite vegetable of most children.

A pamphlet or leaflet, especially one giving descriptive information.
The travel agent gave us a brochure about Florida.

A company providing the services of an intermediary, acting between a buyer and seller.
I have a meeting at the insurance brokerage to review my policy.

Toasted bread drizzled with olive oil and usually topped with diced tomatoes.
He prefers garlic bread to bruschetta because he is not fond of tomatoes.

A heavily-built wild ox, with backswept horns.
A buffalo is found mostly in Old World tropics.

Shaped like a bulb; rounded and/or swollen.
Garlic is a bulbous herb whose cloves are used to flavour food.

A grant of money to a student at a college or university.
The bursary will help pay my tuition expenses.

A unit of volume, equal to just over 35 litres, or a container of such capacity.
I would like to buy a bushel of apples.

Excited activity and movement.
She loved the hustle and bustle of the city streets.

A secret political clique or faction.
The cabal of dissidents planed the coup to overthrow the government.

The right to operate sea, air or other transport services within a certain area.
The union was happy to get cabotage so that the freight was carried by local carriers.

To persuade using flattery or promises.
My mother tried to cajole my brother into helping by telling him she needed his muscles.

A soft, silver-white element which naturally occurs in bones.
Milk is an excellent source of calcium.

Showing cruel disregard for others.
The callous words hurt her feelings very badly.

A unit of energy.
He counted every calorie when he was trying to lose weight.

Slander; a false statement designed to injure the reputation of someone or something.
Although the scientist received a lot of calumny in the newspaper, he pressed on with his research.

A small character part in a play or movie, portrayed by a famous actor.
Alfred Hitchcock was notable for doing a cameo in each of his movies.

A woman’s waist-length, sleeveless under-garment with shoulder straps.
My blouse was sheer so I wore a camisole underneath it.

Concealment that alters or obscures the appearance.
Drab plumage provides female birds with camouflage against predators.

A series of connected activities planned to achieve some goal.
We planned a campaign to raise funds for new computers.

A French-Canadian girl or woman.
Celine Dion is a well-known Canadienne.

A small piece of bread with a savoury topping.
Her favourite canape was smoked salmon.

A long projecting beam fixed only at one end.
The skywalk over the Grand Canyon is a cantilever.

The power or ability to do something.
Watching the runner’s practice really showed his capability to win a medal.

A type of coffee made with espresso and milk.
While waiting for friends in the coffee shop, I drank a cappuccino.

A lively piece of music.
He finished the song with a short capriccio.

A small container, usually round or cylindrical.
The students buried a time capsule on the school grounds to be opened years from now.

Fault-finding.
It’s impolite to utter captious statements about others.

To attract and hold the interest of.
The beauty of the coastal scenery will captivate you on your trip.

A wide-mouthed glass or metal bottle for holding serving beverages.
I broke the carafe for my coffee maker.

A knitted sweater opening down the front.
She selected a long cardigan to go with her dress.

A usually comic representation of a person by exaggeration of characteristics in a picture, writing or mime.
At our school fair we had an artist that could quickly draw a caricature of a subject but still capture a good likeness.

Long-stalked, fragrant flowers in a variety of colours.
A carnation is often worn by both men and women in a bridal party.

A travelling funfair or circus.
The children begged to go to the carnival when it was in town.

A shot in billiards or pool where the ball ricochets off the side or another ball.
His skillful carom helped him win the game.

A merry-go-round; or a rotating conveyer system, especially for passenger luggage at an airport.
Although I checked the carousel, my suitcase was definitely not on it.

The female reproductive part of a flower.
The carpels are typically found in the centre of the flower.

The trade or art of building wooden objects or structures.
Because I like to do woodwork, I’m planning to study carpentry in college.

A person who draws or produces maps.
David Thompson was a renowned explorer, surveyor and cartographer.

A sudden, widespread or extraordinary disaster.
The flood was a catastrophe, leaving thousands of people homeless.

A type of basin or reservoir for catching drainage.
The rainwater collected in the catchment basin.

The wormlike larva of a certain butterfly or a moth.
The caterpillar turned into a beautiful butterfly.

A person who plays the cello which is the second largest member of the violin family.
Yo Yo Ma is a famous cellist.

A shiny, transparent substance made from cellulose, used to package things.
Wrap the sandwiches in cellophane.

A place for burying the dead; a graveyard.
A superstition says to whistle while you walk past the cemetery.

Periods of one hundred years.
The medieval castle had stood for centuries until it was levelled by an earthquake.

An occasion celebrating a particular event or achievement.
The whole family came to the wedding ceremony.

A fixture with branches for lights, usually hanging from the ceiling.
Because of the hanging crystals, it is always a chore to clean the chandelier.

A pretense intended to create a respectable appearance.
His pretending to study was just a charade.

A person falsely claiming to have a special knowledge or skills.
He was so desperate for a cure for cancer that he fell for the claims of a charlatan.

A personal possession.
She asked the insurance company to pay for her stolen chattel.

A person whose work is driving an automobile for others.
The chauffeur will drive you to school.

Stylish and elegant in dress or appearance.
She wore a chic dress for the wedding.

A light, transparent fabric.
Her chiffon dress floated and swirled as she danced.

A cutting tool with a sharp edge at the end of a strong blade.
The carpenter used the chisel to shape the sculpture.

To laugh quietly.
The mother tried not to chuckle when she saw the look on her child’s face.

An electronically generated caption superimposed on a television screen.
The chyron on the newscast identified the person being interviewed.

A place where movies are shown.
They asked their parents for money to go to the cinema.

Movement around something.
In science class, they studied blood circulation.

The use of many words where fewer words will do.
The speech had to be shortened because of its circumlocution.

A small, exclusive group of people.
The mother tried to convince her daughter to avoid becoming part of a clique when she started high school.

A chemical element.
The most common source of cobalt is as a by-product from nickel and copper ore.

An addition that explains or modifies a will or part of one.
The lawyer wrote a codicil to his client’s will.

Extremely large or great.
People often refer to an elephant as being colossal.

Items of food.
They donated comestibles to the food bank.

An expression of opinion.
The journalist wrote a commentary about the current state of politics.

Raw materials or agricultural products that can be bought or sold.
Water is considered one of Canada’s most precious commodities.

An instrument with a magnetic pointer showing the direction of the magnetic north pole.
They were advised to take a compass when walking in the wilderness.

The state of being finished.
Work on the new golf course is nearing completion.

The natural texture, colour and appearance of the skin, especially the face.
She has a beautiful peaches and cream complexion.

Complication or difficulty.
Poverty is an issue of great complexity.

Involving many different and confusing aspects.
She lost her audience when she tried to tell a long and complicated saga.

The make-up or structure of something.
The teacher marked each composition, looking for the structure of the haiku.

Intended or likely to be calming.
The teacher used a conciliatory approach to settle the playground dispute.

Small pieces of coloured paper traditionally thrown after a wedding ceremony.
Each guest got a small package of confetti to toss at the bride and groom.

To use authority to take away someone’s property.
The teacher warned that she would confiscate the ball if they continued to bounce it after the bell rang.

Behaviour in a socially acceptable manner.
The teacher expected conformity to the class rules.

To become semi-solid, especially on cooling.
The children were anxiously waiting for the Jell-O to congeal.

A number of things or parts forming a group or mass.
Rogers Communications is perhaps the largest conglomerate in Canada.

A member of the U.S. congress, which is part of the government.
The congressman was visiting Canada to compare environmental policies.

Relating to a tree that bears cones and is an evergreen.
The source of softwood is coniferous trees.

The compulsory enlistment of people in the armed forces; draft.
Canada used a form of conscription to enlist people during World War II.

The preservation and protection of the natural environment.
The volunteers made a significant difference in the ecology and conservation of the wetland area.

Subject to chance.
Their plan to go on a picnic was contingent on the weather.

A discussion or chat.
The group was deep in conversation about the tariff wars.

Companionable.
The class party was a convivial affair.

A system of parallel mountain ranges.
A good example of cordillera is in the Rockies.

Affecting only the appearance of something, rather than the substance.
The painting of the house was purely cosmetic and not a structural improvement.

Too ready to believe something.
Never be so credulous that you believe everything you are told.

Sad and disappointed.
The team was crestfallen when they didn’t win the championship.

The scientific study of crime.
In criminology, we studied illegal behaviour and the penal system.

Dark, purplish-red.
The actress wore a crimson dress to the gala.

To modify something to suit a particular individual or purpose.
The company said that it could customize its software to meet any need.

The science of communications and automated controls.
The science of cybernetics has discovered many similarities between computers and the human brain.

Centre of attention.
At the wedding, the bride was the cynosure of the day.

The substance within a cell.
The science teacher told us to label the cell membrane, the nucleus and the cytoplasm on the diagram.

A plant widely grown for its variously coloured flower heads.
I think the dahlia is a beautiful garden flower.

A casual or brief relationship.
In high school I had a brief dalliance with country music, but then my tastes changed.

Discouraging; intimidating.
Each labour of Hercules was a daunting task.

To walk slowly or idly; to delay; to waste time.
The boy was dawdling on his way to school.

A first appearance.
The film marked his debut as a director.

Dishonest and misleading to others.
Telephone scams are deceitful.

A trick meant to deceive; a fraud; a sham.
The story he told his mother in order to go to the movies was clearly a deception.

Referring to a tree that sheds its leaves annually.
Every fall the homeowners have to rake the leaves that have fallen from their deciduous trees.

In keeping with good taste or politeness.
The children learned to use their knife and fork in a decorous manner.

More money spent than the amount of money earned.
His credit card was in deficit.

Delicious.
We had a thoroughly enjoyable dinner, followed by a delectable dessert.

Something delightful or pleasing, especially rare or expensive food.
Escargot is a French delicacy.

To describe something precisely.
The company handbook was able to delineate each person’s job.

Temporarily out of one’s senses; raving.
The high fever made him delirious.

Attitude or appearance.
Her demeanour appeared to change from happy to sad for no reason.

A mark against a person’s record given for unsatisfactory performance or behaviour.
The teacher gave him another demerit for his bad behaviour.

The act of tearing something down.
The historical society saved the monument from demolition.

A noun used to denote the inhabitants of a particular country, state, etc.
The demonym for people who live in Canada is Canadian.

Having no money and few possessions.
A homeless person lives a life of hunger and deprivation.

A person or animal that is later in the same family tree of another.
Queen Elizabeth I was a descendant of Henry VIII.

The quality of firmness of purpose.
The student’s determination got her onto the honour roll.

Waste or debris of any kind.
On clean-up day we picked up the detritus of irresponsible litterbugs.

Wet with dew.
The children liked to walk barefoot in the dewy grass in the morning.

A determination of the cause or nature of an illness.
We hope to hear the doctor’s diagnosis today.

Using a straight line to join two opposite corners of a square or rectangle.
She drew a diagonal line from the top right corner of the page to the bottom left corner.

A member of the algae family.
In fossil deposits there might be many forms of diatom.

An airship.
The little boy called out, “Look at the blimp”, when he saw the dirigible fly over the stadium.

Training, especially of the mind or character.
The new recruits were subjected to regular discipline.

Written or verbal communication or debate.
The teacher and student had a discourse on the topic for his science project.

The action or process of talking about something to exchange ideas.
The book discussion brought out many different viewpoints.

Untidy and disordered.
With his unkempt long hair, he had a dishevelled appearance.

Essentially different in kind; without comparison or relation.
My grandmother and grandfather had very disparate interests, yet they were very happily married.

To cut into pieces; to cut apart.
I hope we do not dissect anything in biology class today.

The action of formally ending or dismissing an assembly or partnership.
The prime minister asked the governor general for a dissolution of Parliament.

The action of separating something into parts.
In the math class, they separated blocks into groups to understand the meaning of division.

To disclose; to reveal a secret.
Her friend promised not to divulge the contents of our conversation.

A sedimentary rock.
Limestone and dolomite underlay the glacial deposits.

An area ruled by one person.
The king’s domain stretched from sea to sea.

The monetary unit of Greece prior to the euro.
I hope the drachma in my coin collection has increased in value.

A one-humped camel.
The dromedary, with its long slender legs, was originally bred for racing.

That which can be doubted; uncertain.
He was very dubious about his chances of winning the spelling bee.

Pliant and flexible.
Because silver is ductile, a jeweller is able to draw it out into a thin wire.

A dark underground room in which prisoners are kept.
We expected the ancient castle to have a dungeon.

In music, based on two main beats to the bar.
The composer used both duple and triple time in his composition.

Not performing properly.
The computer was old and becoming dysfunctional.

A deformity or abnormality in the shape or size of a part of the body.
The vet observed that the kittens were suffering from failure to thrive and facial dysmorphia.

A small plant, with white bracts around its small flowers.
A song in the movie, “The Sound of Music”, is named after the alpine flower, edelweiss.

To instruct, especially morally.
Martin Luther King Jr.”s “I have a dream” speech was meant to edify people about human rights.

A newspaper article expressing the editor’s opinion on an issue.
He wrote an editorial outlining the need to combat climate change.

Strange and frightening.
They played eerie music in the haunted house at Halloween.

To rub out; to destroy or wipe out.
Over time, exposure to the elements may efface inscriptions on monuments.

A sculpture or model of a person.
Canadian coins bear an effigy of the monarch on the face.

Detailed and intricate.
The elaborate security details protected the bank from robbery.

The quality of being stylish in appearance or manner.
The gymnast was a picture of elegance.

A select group that is superior in terms of ability.
After the tryouts the best players were selected to make up the elite hockey team.

Difficult to find or achieve.
Prospectors in the Yukon were searching for that elusive gold strike.

To give off; to emit.
A scent will often emanate from a flower.

To get on board a ship or aircraft.
The passengers lined up to embark on their cruise.

To break out from an egg, cocoon or pupa.
The butterfly will emerge from its cocoon when it is fully formed.

A person sent on a special mission, usually diplomatic.
Canada sent an emissary to Greenland.

The production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.
The Paris Accord was designed to reduce the emission of greenhouse gases, among other things.

A Spanish or Lantin American turnover.
She used savoury ingredients to fill her empanada.

A male who is the sovereign ruler of an empire.
There is a classic story of an emperor who was deceived into believing he had wonderful new clothes.

Expressing something forcefully and clearly.
He was emphatic in his denial of the accusation.

To make someone stronger and more confident.
Her goal was to empower the newcomers through strengthening their English skills.

To try to equal or excel, usually with considerable effort.
A parable tells us to emulate the industry of the ant.

To intrude or trespass.
The cat did not like another cat to encroach on his territory.

To put someone or something at risk.
He was driving in a manner that was likely to endanger life.

A plant or animal native to a certain place.
A kangaroo is endemic to Australia.

To occupy wholly; to take up all the attention of.
This is a story that will completely engross you.

A confused mass of something twisted together.
Many dolphins die from entanglement in a fishing net.

An action or undertaking, especially a bold or complex one.
The business was a joint enterprise with his partner.

To fill someone with wonder and delight.
His novels continue to entrance and enthrall readers.

To form a mental picture of.
The architect was able to envisage the completed building.

To imagine.
Can you envision how the characters will appear in the play?

A short quotation at the beginning of a book or chapter intended to suggest its theme.
The epigraph was chosen to entice the reader.

A central nervous system disorder characterized by seizures.
Medications can help a person with epilepsy live a full life.

The repetition of a word or phrase at the end of two or successive verses.
Songs often use epistrophe to emphasize the theme, such as “Rise Up, Rise Up”

A short statement in memory of a dead person.
We found the epitaph carved on the tombstone.

At or near the equator.
The mountain spans five climate zones, from equatorial to arctic.

At equal distances.
The two cities are equidistant from here.

Equal in value or amount.
To make jam stir the equivalent amounts of fruit and sugar together.

To destroy completely.
The use of vaccines has helped to eradicate some diseases.

Relating to or designed for efficiency and comfort in the work place.
The snow shovel’s new ergonomic design puts less strain on the back during snow removal.

To abrade or wear down.
In some places, we can watch the cliffs erode from the waves.

Edible snails that are considered a delicacy.
He ordered escargots as an appetizer to impress his date.

To deliberately avoid using.
He appealed to the protestors to eschew the use of violence.

Particularly; chiefly.
Her new book is designed especially for young readers.

That which makes a thing what it is; the necessary part or parts.
Kindness is the essence of politeness.

An informed guess.
He made an estimation of how much he needed to save to buy the new video game.

The state of belonging to a group with a common national or cultural tradition.
Cultural identity is commonly defined in term of nationality rather than ethnicity.

A speech or writing in honour of a person who has died.
My uncle gave a fine eulogy at his friend’s funeral.

The removal of people from a place of danger.
The evacuation of the people in the burning apartment was carried out swiftly.

To form an idea of the amount, number or value of something.
The audiologist used two tests to evaluate my hearing.

The process of turning liquid into vapour.
When the kettle boils, the steam comes out into the air and disappears as a vapour, which is evaporation.

In the end.
The rain kept them indoors most of the day, but eventually it stopped.

To deprive of essential or vital parts.
Trade wars can eviscerate national economies.

A large water jug with a wide mouth and spout.
The archaeologist found pieces of an ancient ewer at the excavation site.

Unusually good in quality.
The inn was famous for the excellence of its food.

An expulsion of breath.
It was so cold that my exhalation created a little cloud in the air.

To urge strongly.
During an election, the media will exhort the public to think carefully about their choices.

The act of forcing someone to leave.
The expulsion of the Acadians was a sad point in Canadian history.

To erase or wipe out.
He was the kind of person who could expunge unsatisfactory incidents from his memory.

To remove matter seen as unsuitable from a text.
The publisher decided to expurgate some of the passages from the novel before publication.

Extremely beautiful and delicate.
Faberge eggs are exquisite.

To free someone or something from a difficulty.
They had to extricate the ship from the sandbar.

An outgoing and socially confident person.
An extrovert always wants to socialize.

A place, amenity or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose.
Before accepting the invitation, they checked the facilities for parking their car.

Relating to or inclined to dissention.
The disagreement about climate change has led to dissension and a factious parliament.

Uncultivated; ploughed and harrowed but left unsown.
The farmer decided to leave that field fallow this year and plant it next year.

A craftsman who trims horses’ hooves and shoes them.
